units: Nominal monthly simple returns / monthly index changes, decimal fractions

sources.name: Fama/French US market total return and RF, legacy FIZ snapshot
sources.transform: stocks = mktrf + rf; cash = rf. Snapshot columns already decimal fractions.
sources.rights: Copyright Eugene F. Fama and Kenneth R. French; separate attribution from MIT application code.

sources.name: ReturnDataFiles US 10-year sovereign bond nominal total-return proxy
sources.transform: Filter US rows from custom/sov_bonds_erHedgedUSD_nominal_total.csv. Returns reconstructed from yields; not a traded fund.

sources.name: BLS CPI-U all items, via ReturnDataFiles
sources.transform: Monthly nonseasonally adjusted index ratio minus one. General CPI is the proxy for living/other expenses.
sources.rights: US government data; ReturnDataFiles CC0 declaration

sources.name: BLS college tuition and fees CPI, CUUR0000SEEB01
sources.transform: Monthly nonseasonally adjusted index ratio minus one, retrieved through BLS public API in 10-year batches. National proxy includes some financial-aid adjustments.

notes: All five risk factors are aligned on the same observed month. No missing months are filled or fabricated.
1978–2024 is the common complete window; deliberately excludes the 2025 CPI data gap and partial recent years.
Bond returns are a reconstructed 10-year Treasury proxy and monthly-average yields can smooth movements.
Tuition CPI is a national price-change proxy, not a school quote or grant forecast. Housing and other costs use general CPI.
Dataset is a research snapshot, not a forecast. Original source data is not relicensed as MIT.
